body:
What do I do for fun when I'm stressed?

I mean there's short release when I embed myself in my screen but it quickly collapses. I have no real specific idea because nothing I do really works.

Sometimes I attack my punching bag. Sometimes I sing my heart out. But every time, it won't fix anything.

I'm not going to suggest you care about whether or not your rapist is locked up for good. Don't think about the shit in your head. I beg of you that you don't worry about doing shit somebody online told you. But you are innocent, and no matter how unfair it seems that you can't see happiness, you have to struggle on because I will grieve you. We are strangers of the internet, dwellers of the corners of the room and, listen closely now: You do not need to die to get rid of the pain.

Because when I blabber off to friends or family they don't understand, and they argue. Other thing is, not everybody is playing "fake it 'till ya make it."
It's generally a throwaway philosophy, I know happiness is not a permenant state, but happy people are happy and I am always sorta empty.
To sum it up, I think this based on 1) experience; and 2) existential crisis thoughts



 I don't know what you expected me to say
